skill.name: handoff
skill.description: Create a concise, redacted handoff document that helps another agent continue the current conversation.
skill.summary: Transfer active work to a fresh agent without repeating existing project artifacts.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The prompt contains no executable code, network requests, command execution, or injection. Saving conversation content outside the workspace creates low confidentiality risk despite required redaction.

remediation.issue: Conversation-derived content is saved in the OS temporary directory, which may have weaker access controls or retention guarantees.
remediation.suggestion: Require a user-private temporary file, restrictive permissions, a disclosed output path, and cleanup guidance after the next session uses the handoff.

semantic_findings.title: Conversation Content Written Outside Workspace
semantic_findings.description: The skill saves conversation-derived content in the OS temporary directory. Required redaction reduces, but does not eliminate, unintended local disclosure.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The external temporary-directory write and redaction requirement are explicit. Actual exposure depends on operating-system permissions and generated content.

low_findings.title: Conversation Content Written Outside Workspace
low_findings.description: The skill saves conversation-derived content in the OS temporary directory. Required redaction reduces, but does not eliminate, unintended local disclosure.
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: The external temporary-directory write and redaction requirement are explicit. Actual exposure depends on operating-system permissions and generated content.

content.value_statement: Long conversations make session changes difficult and can expose sensitive details. This skill creates a concise, redacted handoff that references existing artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the current conversation for a fresh agent.
Tailors the handoff to the next session focus supplied by the user.
Suggests relevant skills for the next agent to invoke.
References existing artifacts by path or URL instead of duplicating their content.
Directs the agent to redact secrets and personally identifiable information.
Saves the handoff in the operating system temporary directory.
limitations: The handoff only reflects context available in the current conversation.
It does not validate referenced artifacts or confirm that the next agent can access them.
Saving the document requires agent filesystem access outside the current workspace.
It suggests skills but does not invoke them for the next agent.

use_cases.title: Continue Implementation
use_cases.description: Prepare continuity notes before moving implementation work to a new AI session.

use_cases.title: Transfer Project Decisions
use_cases.description: Summarize decisions and artifact references so another agent can continue a coordinated project.

use_cases.title: Redact Operational Context
use_cases.description: Create a redacted transfer document when active context contains credentials or personal data.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff for the next session.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a general continuation with minimal guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff focused on completing the authentication tests. Reference existing plans and redact secrets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue a defined task in a fresh session.

prompt_templates.title: Artifact-Aware Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a handoff for deployment work. Link relevant commits, issues, and ADRs without repeating their content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Transfer work supported by several durable project artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Investigation Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff for a fresh agent investigating the production regression. Prioritize verified evidence, unresolved questions, constraints, and suggested skills.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preserve complex investigation context for advanced follow-up.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff focused on finishing the payment integration.
output_examples.output: The handoff summarizes completed work, names the next task, references the implementation plan, and lists open validation steps.

output_examples.input: Create a handoff and remove the credential mentioned earlier.
output_examples.output: The handoff omits the credential, records that redaction occurred, and preserves only the operational context needed for continuation.

output_examples.input: Transfer the production regression investigation to another agent.
output_examples.output: The handoff prioritizes the reported regression, links the issue and diff, identifies unresolved evidence, and recommends relevant debugging skills.

best_practices: Provide a clear focus argument when the next session has a specific objective.
Keep durable decisions in existing artifacts and reference their paths or URLs.
Review the generated handoff for sensitive data and missing context before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not use the handoff as a substitute for project documentation.
Do not include secrets, passwords, tokens, or unnecessary personal information.
Do not assume the next agent can access local paths, private URLs, or uncommitted changes.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a concise handoff document that helps a fresh agent continue the current conversation.

faq.question: Where is the handoff saved?
faq.answer: It is saved in the operating system temporary directory, not the current workspace.

faq.question: Does the handoff duplicate existing documents?
faq.answer: No. It references PRDs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, and diffs by path or URL.

faq.question: How does it handle sensitive information?
faq.answer: It directs the agent to redact API keys, passwords, and personally identifiable information.

faq.question: Can I focus the next session on a specific task?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass the next session objective as an argument, and the handoff will prioritize that objective.

faq.question: Can the model invoke this skill automatically?
faq.answer: No. Its metadata disables model invocation, so users must start it explicitly.
